title: Restart Servex so the log sweeper picks up its wider allowlist

owner_note.text: git status went from 37 dirty lines to 0 (live agents re-dirty it with task.jsonl appends between sweeps). The running sweeper still has the old allowlist; to cover usage, cards, files.jsonl, index.json and day.jsonl run `node Servex/sustain.mjs --restart` when no agents are working. Why agents still write to the main tree, and an unbuilt Edit/Write warning hook (your call: warn or block), are in sessions/doc/commit-rule.md.
